description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models on various morphosyntactic features, including case, gender, tag, number, and tense. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis categorizes the morphosyntactic features. Each bar is color-coded to represent a specific model: XLM-L2 (light blue), mBERT-R2 (green), XLM-R2 (red), mBERT-B2 (pink), and XLM-B2 (dark blue). The bars vary in height, indicating the magnitude of the effect each model has on the respective feature. The chart includes error bars, suggesting variability or confidence intervals around the effect estimates. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting of the bars or any visual emphasis on specific bars.
